prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-99823 for Eastgate Clinics
prose.body:
Hi team at Eastgate Clinics,

I hope you’re having a productive week! I’m just popping in with a quick, friendly reminder regarding Invoice INV-99823 for your recent order from Pembury Supply. The total amount due is 8554.36 USDC.

To keep our books balanced and your account in good standing, please process the payment at your earliest convenience. You can send the funds directly to our standard vendor wallet: 0xb9587737686c9cfdc43b0ead0f48320b44fd4dbb. This is the same address we’ve used for our previous transactions, so it should look familiar in your records.

If you’ve already sent the payment, please ignore this note and thank you in advance! If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy of the receipt, just hit reply and we’ll sort it out immediately.

Thanks for being such a great partner. We really appreciate your business!

Best regards,

The Accounts Team
Pembury Supply
